report.sent: Thank you. Your report has reached the admin.
report.asVisitor: It is sent without an account. Leave an email if you want an answer.

errors.tooManyReports: You've sent five reports in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.reportKind: Choose what the report is about.
errors.reportEmail: That email address does not look right.

privacy.reports: A problem report keeps what you write: its kind, the text and the email if you give one. Sent while signed in, it keeps your account; sent from the game, also the world, the screen you were on, the game's build and your browser. It never keeps your IP address. A report is deleted a year after the admin closes it.
